snapshot.source: Hand-seeded from known LGBCE boundary reviews + Makerfield/Wigan dossier. Predecessor maps tell the model: when a new ward has no historical baseline, inherit from this list of predecessor wards.
snapshot.coverage_note: Seed set: Wigan 2023 review (9 wards). Other reviews to be added as we onboard their councils.

wigan/ashton-in-makerfield-south.source: Wigan LGBCE 2023 review; Ashton ward split into Ashton-in-Makerfield North + South

wigan/bryn-with-ashton-in-makerfield-nor.source: Wigan LGBCE 2023 review; merged Bryn with north Ashton

wigan/hindley.source: Wigan LGBCE 2023 review; Hindley boundary recut but kept name (geographic split with Hindley Green)

wigan/hindley-green.source: Wigan LGBCE 2023 review; Hindley Green carved from larger Hindley
